## Episode Thesis

Folksam chief economist Marcus Svedberg describes his study trip to China and Japan. China's economy is split: subsidised strategic sectors face brutal domestic competition, while demographics, the property crisis and weak consumption hold growth back. Exports are being pushed toward Europe, which puts pressure on Swedish and European companies. Japan is entering a new era of rising inflation and higher rates, which may strengthen the yen, hurt the big exporters and favour domestically focused companies. The host's takeaway was to buy domestically producing Japanese and Chinese companies.
